snippet.title: Sega Saturn - Gekiretsu Pachinkazu (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Gekiretsu Pachinkazu is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Planning Office Wada and published by BMG Interactive Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1996.
